title: Study Time
text:
I have a set of flashcards for English. Each card has a picture on the front. On the back, there is the word.

I look at the cards before school. Sometimes my sister studies with me. We say the words together and laugh.

questions.text: What is on the front of each card?
When does the writer look at the cards?
How does the writer probably feel when studying with the cards?
Who is the writer probably studying with?

vocabulary.definition: small cards with information used for studying
a girl or woman who has the same parents as you
with another person or people, not alone

paragraph_translations: Eu tenho um conjunto de cartões de estudo para inglês. Cada cartão tem uma imagem na frente. No verso, há a palavra.
Eu olho os cartões antes da escola. Às vezes minha irmã estuda comigo. Nós falamos as palavras juntos e rimos.
